title: inspect
description: The inspector's own state, in a page's own graph: never synced, gone with the page.

inspector.description: the inspector's page, on the entity `inspect`: the page being edited, a note open, a delete armed, a refused write and the slice of the schema its map shows; what the index's field holds is the same entity's `filter` (@yaks/filter)

editing.description: the eid of the entity whose page shows its controls: a page is read until the reader asks to edit it

note.description: the heading whose note line is open, `<eid> <heading>`

armed.description: the eid of the entity whose delete was pressed once; a second press deletes it

said.description: why the graph refused the last write, until the next one lands

at.description: where the refused write came from: a note's key, or the eid of the entity it was about

slice.description: the slice of the schema the map shows; packages when none is chosen

table.description: one table on an inspector page, how its rows run, which page of them shows and which of its rows are open; its id is `<eid> <heading>`

order.description: the property its rows run by, `-` before it when they run down

after.description: the last row of each page before the one shown, the way back

open.description: the eids of the rows showing the rows they hold, in a table that is a tree

rank.description: its values are ranked though ranking them reads every entity carrying them
